answer: Challenge-bound credential issuance. Each agent must answer a fresh, randomly seeded task whose correct output is entangled with the seed, so precomputed answers cannot be replayed and only live computation yields the onyx token needed to transact. A marble-grade hardware attestation signs the answer, binding it to one physical execution unit per epoch. An attacker pays full compute per identity plus hardware acquisition, while crowding the meadow of valid seeds with duplicates is detected and rejected.
